meta.title: Budget Agent — know where every cent went
meta.description: Photograph a receipt: every line is read, sorted into categories and products, and priced across shops. Income, bills and taxes counted, a shared family budget, goals the AI checks. Any currency.

hero.title: Know where every cent went.
hero.lead: Snap a receipt. Every line is read, sorted and priced — so you see what is left this month, what got dearer, and where it is cheaper. In any currency.
hero.free: Free · 10 receipts a month · no card

versus.othersText: One total filed under “Groceries”. Was it food? Cleaning? The kids’ crayons? Nobody knows.

shoot.title: Photograph or forward
shoot.text: One photo, a few overlapping ones for a long receipt, or the e-receipt sent to your own address.

check.title: Check what was read
check.text: Every line with its price and category. Anything unsure is marked for you, never quietly guessed.

see.title: See what is left
see.text: The month by category, your income and bills, and what each product costs in each shop.

home.label: Home
home.title: What is left this month
home.text: One ring for the month: what is left of the budget, of the income after bills and taxes, or where the money went — a tap switches between them.
points: Income after tax, regular bills taken off first
A daily pace for the days left
Anything waiting for you, in one place

spending.label: Spending
spending.title: Where the money went
spending.text: Categories against last month, day by day, and the receipts behind each — for you or the whole household.
points: This month, last month, the year or your own dates
A bar a day, in two colours for a couple

products.label: Products
products.title: The same milk, cheaper next door
products.text: One product however each shop prints it, its price over time, and the shop that sold it for less — from your own receipts.
points: Price history per product and shop
A mark when another shop is cheaper
Sets of products to watch together

plan.label: Plan
plan.title: Income, bills, holidays, goals
plan.text: Regular income and bills set once, taxes if you pay them yourself, a holiday with its own budget, and goals the AI checks against what you really buy.
points: Spent · bills · free in one bar
Goals with advice from your receipts
Business trips with a per diem and a settlement

features.title: Made for how a family really spends

items.title: Every line, not just the total
items.text: Name, quantity and price of each line; totals that do not add up are explained, and a missed discount is one tap.

items.title: Prices across your shops
items.text: Each product however it is printed, its price history and where it is cheaper — from your receipts only.

items.title: Income, taxes and bills
items.text: Regular income and bills set once; if you pay your own taxes, Home shows what is really yours.

items.title: One budget for the family
items.text: Invite with a link. Everyone keeps their receipts; private ones count as money only.

items.title: Holidays and business trips
items.text: A holiday with its own budget; a business trip kept out of yours and settled with a per diem, as PDF or CSV.

items.title: Your receipts stay yours
items.text: Encrypted at rest, seen only by you and your household, deleted with your account.

free.title: Free to start. Really.
free.text: 10 receipts read a month with every feature. Expenses you type in never count. No card, no trial that runs out.

items.a: Yes while in beta: 10 receipts read a month with every feature. Expenses typed in by hand never count.
Any. Your account keeps its own currency, and a receipt in another one is converted at the rate of its day. The app speaks English, Ukrainian and Polish, with more languages to come.
Photos and PDFs of shop receipts, and e-receipts forwarded by email. A long receipt can be shot in a few overlapping parts.

items.q: What if I paid in cash and have no receipt?
items.a: Type it in: what, when and how much. It counts like any receipt.
Only you — and your household, unless you mark a receipt private. Data is encrypted at rest and deleted with your account.
It works in any phone browser and can be added to the home screen. An Android app is on its way.

final.title: Your first receipt takes a minute.
